## Installation

You can install the development version from [GitHub](https://github.com/{{github_account}}/templateRpackage):

- Using [`remotes`](https://remotes.r-lib.org/):

```{r eval = FALSE}
## install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("{{github_account}}/templateRpackage")
```

- Or using [`pak`](https://pak.r-lib.org/):

```{r eval = FALSE}
## install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("{{github_account}}/templateRpackage")
```
